spiffsgen.py is the SPIFFS image generator from ESP-IDF by Espressif Systems,
released under the Apache License 2.0, kept here unmodified with its original
header. Revenant uses it only to build genuine SPIFFS images for its tests and
samples, so the SPIFFS parser is checked against a layout it did not write.
Source: https://github.com/espressif/esp-idf/blob/master/components/spiffs/spiffsgen.py
